quote: p27 note '3. Claims outstanding', 2015 table (Gross | Reinsurer's Share | Net, GBP000): 'At 1 January 2015 96,644 (19,341) 77,303'; 'Claims incurred in current underwriting year (8,135) (387) (8,522)'; 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 5,269 (976) 4,293'; 'Claims paid during the year (8,304) 1,767 (6,537)'; 'Foreign exchange 2,287 (450) 1,837'; 'At 31 December 2015 87,761 (19,387) 68,374'. 2014 table: 'Claims incurred in current underwriting year 856 (176) 680'; 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year (16,240) 1,948 (14,291)'. p41 'Gross insurance contract outstanding claims provision as at 31 December 2015' (columns Before 2011, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, Total): 'Estimate of cumulative claims incurred at end of underwriting year 859 5,368' [2014, 2015]; '12 months later 2,051' [2014]; 'Total gross outstanding claims provision per the statement of financial position 81,104 - - - 1,609 5,048 87,761'. p5 KPIs (2015 | 2014, GBPm): 'Net incurred claims – live business (5.5) (0.7)'; 'Net incurred claims – legacy business 9.7 14.3'. p6: 'The Agency has seen continued favourable development on the RITC contracts written by the Syndicate.' ... 'including releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts.'
arithmetic: In the 2015 column the two claims-incurred rows are transposed (see census). The row printed 'prior underwriting year', gross 5,269, is the 2015 year of account's own claims: the triangle's 2015 first estimate is 5,368 (p41; difference 99 = 1.8%, triangle translated at end-of-underwriting-year rates). The earlier years' movement is the other row, gross (8,135) = -8.135m. Cross-checks: (i) total gross claims incurred = paid 8,304 less the decrease in gross claims outstanding 11,170 (p13) = -2,866 = -8,135 + 5,269; less the 2015 first estimate 5,368 leaves -8,234 for earlier years (within 99 of -8,135). (ii) Net, p5 KPIs: live business (5.5) = 2015 year 4,293 + the 2014 year's development (gross 859 -> 2,051 = +1,192, p41); legacy release 9.7 less that ~1.2 = 8.5 = the (8,522) row. Under the printed labels the 2015 year would carry negative claims of 8,135 gross, against the triangle's 5,368. Filing figure -8.135m; adopted +5.3m; difference 13.435 > tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 5.3 = 0.265) = 0.5; signs opposite. Criteria (a), (b) and (c) all hold; the kind recorded is scope-recent-years because the adopted figure is the 2015 underwriting year's own claims. Excluding the 2014 year (+1.192m) would give about -9.3m, the same conclusion.
basis_check: Note 3 (p27) prints separate Gross, Reinsurer's Share and Net columns; the adopted 5,269 and the filing's (8,135) are both in the Gross column. The p41 triangle is headed 'Gross insurance contract outstanding claims provision'. The p5 KPIs are net ('Net incurred claims') and are used only as a cross-check.
page_binding_check: Yes. Every page is headed 'Vibe Syndicate Management Limited (formerly RITC Syndicate Management Ltd) - Syndicate 5678', and the report covers Syndicate 5678 alone (p5: 'Syndicate 5678 was originally formed with the primary objective of providing Reinsurance to Close'). The 5,269 sits in the 2015 table, not the 2014 comparative.
triangle_arithmetic: Not applicable: route rag_provisions, no code override. For context, the p41 gross triangle shows development only for the 2014 year (859 -> 2,051 = +1.192m); the legacy 'Before 2011' reserves (81,104) have no development rows, so the triangle cannot give the prior-year figure.
reasoning: The adopted figure is the printed 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' line. But the filing's own triangle, KPI table and narrative make plain that the 2015 column has the current- and prior-year rows transposed: 5,269 is the 2015 year of account's claims (first estimate 5,368), and earlier years released 8,135 gross (legacy RITC releases, p6). The 2014 comparative is in the right order (current 856 against the 2014 first estimate 859; net 680 = KPI live (0.7); net (14,291) = KPI legacy 14.3), so the labels are not a sign convention. So the adopted +5.3 is the report year's own claims, and it has the opposite sign to the filing's -8.135 prior-year release.

transposed.evidence: p27 2015 Gross: 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 5,269'; p41: 'Estimate of cumulative claims incurred at end of underwriting year 859 5,368', so the 2015 first estimate of 5,368 is within 1.8% of 5,269. The printed 'Claims incurred in current underwriting year (8,135)' cannot be the 2015 year's claims (negative, against 5,368). Comparative: the 2014 prior-year line '(16,240)' does not match the 2014 first estimate 859, whereas the 2014 current-year line '856' does, so the 2014 column is in the right order and the transposition is confined to 2015. Net KPIs p5 'Net incurred claims – live business (5.5) (0.7)' and 'Net incurred claims – legacy business 9.7 14.3' match the 2014 net lines as printed (680; (14,291)) but the 2015 net lines only transposed (4,293 + the 2014 year's ~1.2 = 5.5; (8,522) = the 9.7 legacy release less ~1.2).

provisions_row.evidence: The row read is p27 note '3. Claims outstanding', 2015 table, Gross column: 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 5,269'. By name and by its place in the roll-forward (between 'Claims incurred in current underwriting year' and 'Claims paid during the year') it is the movement line for earlier years' claims, not a premium, a balance or a class. The column is the report year's (2015 Gross; the 2014 table prints '(16,240)' on this row). Its 2015 value is transposed with the current-year line, which is answered under transposed.
